title: Agent4Spec: An LLM-based Agentic System to Optimize API Specifications through Automated Validation and Market Analysis
abstract: arXiv:2610.13273v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: API specifications serve as critical documentation for modern software development, directly impacting integration efficiency and client code generation. While recent advancements have leveraged Large Language Models (LLMs) to generate initial specifications from source code, existing approaches treat this process as a one-time event - overlooking the needs for continuous validation, long-term maintenance, and market-driven evolution of these artifacts. translated_title: Agent4Spec：一个基于大语言模型的智能体系统，通过自动化验证与市场分析优化API规范
translated_abstract: API规范是现代软件开发的关键文档，直接影响集成效率和客户端代码生成。尽管近期的研究进展已利用大语言模型（LLM）从源代码生成初始规范，但现有方法将这一过程视为一次性事件，忽视了对这些工件进行持续验证、长期维护以及市场驱动演进的需求。为解决这一问题，我们提出了Agent4Spec，这是一个自主的多智能体框架，包含两条不同的流水线：（1）验证流水线，用于检测并自我纠正OpenAPI语法错误；（2）市场分析流水线，用于开展竞争性研究、识别与行业领先者相比的功能差距，并自动生成缺失的API规范功能。我们在两个精心整理的API规范数据集上对Agent4Spec进行了评估，涵盖通用型和行业特定型的API规范。
tldr: Agent4Spec提出了一个自主多智能体框架，通过验证流水线自动检测并纠正OpenAPI语法错误，同时通过市场分析流水线开展竞争研究、识别与行业领先者的功能差距并自动生成缺失的API规范功能，实现了API规范的持续优化与演进。
en_tdlr: Agent4Spec is an autonomous multi-agent framework that continuously optimizes API specifications through a validation pipeline that detects and self-corrects OpenAPI syntax errors, and a market analysis pipeline that conducts competitive research, identifies functional gaps against industry leaders, and automatically generates missing API-spec functionalities.
